answer: Treat trust like marble dust carried by random walks: each epoch, honest seed agents release short walks along the graph of real paid jobs, and an agent's weight is how much dust lands on it. A sybil farm can trade endlessly inside itself, but only a thin delta of edges links it to honest work, so little dust crosses in. No secret cipher is needed; to gain weight the attacker must win genuine jobs from outsiders, costing real labour per fake.
